notes.title: MINERALS UPDATE IS LIVE!
notes.content:
Use your gold to spawn precious minerals. The more you spawn, the higher the cost. But don’t worry, prices gradually drop back over time.

Combine two identical minerals to create a rarer one and generate maximum Value Points (VP)!

Spend your VP strategically to unlock upgrades: higher base mineral levels, expanded grid size, boosted gold generation, increased luck… and much more!

Merge, optimize, progress…



Polish Prestige

Once you obtain a level 30 mineral, you unlock the ability to perform a Polish Prestige, granting you valuable Polish Points (PP).

Use them to upgrade five legendary weapons, each offering unique bonuses.

Reach key milestones to unlock exclusive content, powerful upgrades… and the Insane Trials!



Refine Tree

Once you obtain a level 70 mineral, you unlock the Refine Prestige and earn Refine Points (RfP), calculated based on your highest mineral level achieved.



Spend these RfP in a massive upgrade tree:

Square nodes offer one-time unique bonuses

Circle nodes can be upgraded multiple times



Unlock a wealth of new features and exclusive bonuses:

Magnets: Merge common minerals for a chance to gain magnets, which can be spent on extra bonuses

Merge Level: Gain experience with every merge to greatly boost your VP gain

Polish Enhancement: Make your Polish weapons even more powerful

Sun ☀️ and Moon 🌙 Runes: Use them to summon special minerals or unlock powerful upgrades

Special Minerals: Discover 10 rare types, each offering unique bonuses

Special Minerals Progression (SMP): Evolve your special minerals with each merge so they spawn at higher levels next time and use RfP to enhance their effectiveness even further!



NEW FEATURES

🆕 Minerals

🆕 Polish Prestige

🆕 Refined Tech Tree

🆕 80 New Achievements

🆕 15 New Relics

🆕 Insane Trials

🆕 Automation for Buy and Ascend Attacks

🆕 Added wiki.gg link to the Help section



TWEAKS & IMPROVEMENTS

⚙️ Buffed Boosts (Revolution, Infinity, Eternity)

⚙️ Updated Infinity Pack



FIXES

🐛 Fixed Orbital skin not being recovered after save reset

🐛 Fixed a bug where converted TF could crash the page

🐛 Fixed an issue where the Banana skin would sometimes disappear



Thank you for giving us more time to finalize everything, once again, our apologies. We hope you'll enjoy this update!

notes.title: Mineral Update Delay
notes.content:
Greetings Revolutionners, 



We have an important update to share: the Mineral update will be delayed. We know this isn’t the news you were hoping for.



Our team has been working hard to deliver it on time, but we need a bit more time to ensure it meets the quality standards you deserve. 



Since this is the second delay, we’ve decided not to set a new ETA for now. Instead, we’ll release the update once it’s fully ready, and it may even drop without a prior announcement. 



Thank you for your patience and continued support.



The Revolution Team

notes.title: Revolution Idle Changelog V1.013

Dear Demons,


A major update has just landed! 

We’ve listened to your feedback and made overall improvements to Revo.



The macro system has been completely redesigned. It's now simpler, more practical, and easier to use.

You can now export and import macros using the Revoscript format. 

Three new blocks have also been added, go check them out!



Two new skins just dropped! 

Also, try to unlock the two new secret achievements… a surprise awaits!


About the minerals update


We’re pushing the release back by one week, now set for June 27. 

"A delayed game is eventually good, but a rushed game is forever bad." — Gabe Newell (Steam founder)

notes.title: 🌾Grass Cutting Incremental is coming to Steam & REVO Massive Minerals Update!!
notes.content:
We’ve got some massive announcements to share!


🌾Grass Cutting Incremental is coming to Steam, Android, and iOS in partnership with LethalDolphin!

Yes you read that right! We’re beyond excited to officially announce that Oni Gaming will be publishing and porting the legendary Roblox incremental game Grass Cutting Incremental, originally created by LethalDolphin.

This isn’t just a quick port — it's a full rebuild for PC and mobile, with:

 A brand-new UI and design tailored for Steam and mobile platforms.
 Touch controls and performance optimization.
 New features and systems to elevate the gameplay experience.
The original creator, LethalDolphin, is actively involved and will supervise the project to ensure the new version stays true to the original spirit while pushing the experience further.

Don’t expect a release before 2026, but we’ll be sharing progress and previews along the way.
We’re hiring for this game, recruitment info at the end.


🟡 REVO - Massive Minerals Update Incoming!

The next REVO update is currently in testing and aims for a release around June 20. That’s an approximate date, so stay tuned in #revo-spoiler for previews!

This update is huge, focusing entirely on Minerals, and brings:

 Crafting mechanics using minerals.
 Polish Prestige allowing you to buy and upgrade 5 unique weapons with specifics power.
 Refine Tree with 80-100 upgrade nodes.
 10 types of Special Minerals, each upgradable.
 Runes Upgrades Sun and Moon.


To Our Amazing Community ❤️

With over 90,000 demons in our Discord, we’re constantly humbled by your passion and support. While many of you are eagerly waiting for new games and features, we want to reaffirm this:

 We will always prioritize quality over quantity.
 Every update, system, and game is built with love, care, and polish to make sure your experience is the best it can be (well, most of the time 😈).
Thank you for being a part of this journey. More is coming. Stay tuned!

The Oni Gaming Team
